LOOK: Firefighters continue to put out a fire that broke out inside Gaisano Grand Citygate Mall in Buhangin, Davao City, on Friday afternoon, Jan. 2.

The fire, which reportedly started around 3 p.m., has now reached the third alarm, according to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP). 

📸: Keith Bacongco/MB

WATCH: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) has reopened repaired sections of the Edsa Busway, covering the southbound lane from Edsa-Orense to Taft Avenue and the northbound lane from Magallanes back to Orense in Makati.

Starting Jan. 5, repair work along the busway will be carried out nightly from 10 p.m. to 4 a.m. to avoid disrupting rush-hour traffic. | 🎥: DPWH
